title: Offer high-value Home Screen quick actions

statement.en: Create Home Screen quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks people can start without opening the app first.
statement.ja: アプリを先に開かず開始できる、価値の高いタスクをHome Screen quick actionとして提供する。

conditions: People generally expect at least one useful quick action.
An app can provide up to four quick actions.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Home Screen quick actions experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるHome Screen quick actionsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Create Home Screen quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks people can start without opening the app first.” in the documented Home Screen quick actions context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Create Home Screen quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks people can start without opening the app first.

apple_native_rule: Create Home Screen quick actions for compelling, high-value tasks people can start without opening the app first.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Keep dynamic quick-action changes predictable

statement.en: Avoid changing dynamic quick actions in ways people can't predict.
statement.ja: dynamic quick actionを、利用者が予測できない形で変更しない。

conditions: Relevance-based changes may use current location, recent app activity, time of day, or settings changes when the result remains predictable.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Home Screen quick actions experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Use familiar icons for Home Screen quick actions

statement.en: Provide a familiar interface icon for every Home Screen quick action, preferring SF Symbols where suitable.
statement.ja: 各Home Screen quick actionに馴染みのあるUIアイコンを付け、適切な場合はSF Symbolsを優先する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

title: Avoid emoji as quick-action icons

statement.en: Avoid using an emoji in place of a symbol or interface icon for a Home Screen quick action.
statement.ja: Home Screen quick actionのシンボルまたはUIアイコンの代わりに絵文字を使わない。

conditions: Quick-action symbols are monochromatic and adapt in Dark Mode, unlike full-color emoji.
